🚨Megan Thee Stallion has announced that May 1st will be her last day performing in 'Moulin Rouge', The Musical. The Breakfast Club weighs in and @lorenlorosa has the latest!

Video

🚨 The @blackeffect podcast festival was this past weekend and a lot went down and the people showed up and showed out! Tap in as @lorenlorosa breaks down it all down!

Video

🦅🦅🦅😝ahhhh today is Jess Hilarious’ BIG DAY! Her book, ‘TIL Death Do We Parent’ 📕 is finally available for a goodt read 🥳! Tap in RN, you know we’re about to go up all morning ! Listen live ➡️ Breakfastclubonline.com/list…

🚨Donkey of the Day goes to Dana Bash, who was discussing the recent shooting at the WHCD with Rep. Jamie Raskin and inquired whether he and the left should reconsider toning down their Trump rhetoric.... Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 @mariocarbone is known for his fine dining experience at his super-exclusive restaurants @carbonerestaurants , but he has been able to take that same quality and bring it to supermarkets for all to enjoy ! How did he know he wasn’t compromising his product with mass production? Tap into the full conversation on @netflix.

Video

The Michael Jackson film has made $217.4M worldwide, making it the highest-grossing biopic opening ever! Tap into the latest with @lorenlorosa!

Video

🗞️April Ryan ( @adr1600 ) speaks out about her experience at this year’s White House Correspondents’ Dinner and how the security this year was lacking! Tap into the Front Page News 📰 w/ @mimibrowntv !

Video

🚨Megan Thee Stallion announces on social media that Klay Thompson has been creeping, and @lorenlorosa breaks it down in the latest!

Video

🚨 @ninaturnerohio reflects on endorsing Bernie Sanders in the past and expresses the importance of not holding blind allegiance to any political party, and why questioning parties are necessary. Full conversation on @netflix !

Video

🚨 @ninaturner  breaks down the confusion surrounding the Target boycott and explains the difference between the “Target Fast” and the “Target Boycott”. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🛸 Donkey of the Day goes to us, the American people 😳!  Scientists connected to research on UFOs, rocket technology, and nuclear secrets have been reported dead or missing! 👽🛸 There is no such thing as coincidences people… Get your Tin-foiled Pooh Shiesty ready and Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

After 8 seasons and 156 episodes, @CedEntertainer  The Neighborhood has concluded, and he reflects on what an amazing experience it was to create such magic for so long with a great cast. How did production costs lead to the end of an era? Check out the full conversation on Netflix.

Video

🚨 Michael Jackson’s film has received mixed reviews. Rotten Tomatoes gave it a low score, while an audience-driven rating system like “Popcorn” has scored the film at 96%! Tap in to hear why in the latest with @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 @cedtheentertainer came through to promote his Broadway debut in the play Joe Turner’s Come and Gone, and we learn that Cedric shares a hard lesson about gambling with Michael Jordan. Check out the full interview on @netflix !

Video

🚨 Snoop Dogg is catching heat after a video went viral of a little girl on stage with him, having fun next to a stripper 🩰. Allegedly, the child was placed on stage by her parents so while the baby was clapping, so were the cheeks on stage! 😳 There are a lot of questions here, but why are y’all mad at Snoop? Why was the child at a 4/20 event??? Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🗣️🎙️ @ninaturner  will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow, discussing the political landscape, the issues we're dealing with daily and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🗣️🎙️ @CedEntertainer  will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow, promoting his role on Broadway in Joe Turner’s Come and Gone! Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🤔 Jess Fix My Mess: Caller needs to know what she should do about her long-distance situationship 👀!

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to Ashley Gonzalez for recording her racism and expressing how much she couldn’t stand Black people. Why is this problematic? Well, Ashley is a relieved police officer for the Houston Police Department 😳. Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 Snoop Dogg is catching heat after a video went viral of a little girl on stage with him, having fun next to a stripper 🩰. Allegedly, the child was placed on stage by her parents—so while the baby was clapping her hands, so were the cheeks on stage! 😳Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.
